name: Steve Hughes

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single primary residence, along with multiple detached outbuildings and sheds|A paved driveway curves through the property, providing access to the main house and other structures|The lot includes large open lawn and field areas, with dense mature trees bordering much of the perimeter

alpha.desc: The front of the residence shows the main house with a covered or extended entry area|A paved driveway leads toward the house, running in front of it and straight back to the rear of the property|Mature trees are visible along the sides, with open lawn space in front|Small, landscaped shrubs run the length of the front of the house

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the main house and several outbuildings|Dense mature trees line this side|Open field and lawn areas are visible between structures|The view also provides a clear look at a canal that runs diagonally across the property with water in it

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the back of the main house and additional outbuildings|Large open lawn and field areas extend between the structures|Trees border the rear perimeter|The canal runs across the back of the property|The driveway running in front of the house is a loop that can circle back to the road or continue to the back of the property.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the main house and outbuildings with a paved driveway running through|The driveway as well as a small footbridge spans the canal|Dense mature trees are present along this side, with open areas between the buildings.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that curves through the property and connects the main house with multiple outbuildings. The large open lawn and field areas provide good space for movement and staging. Dense mature trees along the perimeter may limit visibility from the street and between some sections of the property. The multiple structures and open layout allow relatively clear access around the main residence, though the tree coverage could affect sightlines in certain areas.
clarifications: Is the driveway exit out the back of the property? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the property? Is vehicle access available to all outbuildings and the rear of the main house? Are there any additional access points or pathways not visible from the available imagery? How does the surrounding agricultural land and rural road access affect staging and emergency response?
